text:
Jess: Heads-up — got feedback from a customer about the vector preview export flow. They expected a simple "copy to clipboard" icon to copy the CSV but it only copies the vector JSON. Confusing.
Amar: ugh. That's by-design from the earlier iteration but sounds like bad discoverability. Do we have analytics on how often they use the CSV export vs JSON copy?
Jess: Not exact counts, but support flagged 3 tickets this week. One included a screenshot where the icon tooltip says ‘copy’ — not specific.
Lee: Can we change the tooltip to ‘Copy CSV’ vs ‘Copy JSON’? Also maybe add a small dropdown on the icon for format.
Sam: Dropdown is heavier. Maybe single click = CSV, long-press or alt+click = JSON? But long-press on desktop is odd.
Priya: Accessibility-wise, long-press patterns are problematic. Keyboard users need explicit actions. Would prefer separate buttons or a menu trigger that is keyboard-focusable.
a11y-bot: Note: screen readers will announce the button label. Avoid ambiguous labels like 'Copy'. Use 'Copy table as CSV' or 'Copy vectors as JSON'.
Amar: Good call. Proposed microcopy: primary button 'Copy CSV' and a secondary 'Copy JSON' in the overflow menu. Primary is what most users want for exports.
Jess: For the export CSV, we should also include header columns: id, text_snippet, vector_norm, relevance_score. Customer expected the snippet column but got full text -> privacy issue.
Lee: Oh — we currently include full_text when the batch is small. We can truncate to first 200 chars for preview CSV and add a note in the export modal.
Sam: Implementation note: backend already has a CSV serializer, need to add truncation flag and switch in the frontend call. Quick snippet for truncation in frontend:
```
// example
const csvRows = items.map(i => ({
  id: i.id,
  text_snippet: i.text.slice(0,200),
  vector_norm: norm(i.vector),
  relevance_score: i.score
}));
```
Priya: For keyboard we should surface ARIA labels: `aria-label="Copy table as CSV"` on the primary button and `aria-haspopup="menu"` for the overflow. Also ensure menu items have role="menuitem" and are focusable.
Jess: UX question — where do we put the export CTA? Current placement is on the right of the table header. Some PMs think it should be grouped with the table view controls (filters/sort) on the left.
Amar: My vote: keep it on the right but visually group with other actions (icon cluster). Left side is for stateful controls (filters). Right side is action-oriented (export, bulk operations).
Lee: Agree with Amar. But make sure the cluster compresses at small widths — convert to a single kebab menu that contains export options.
Sam: Another nit: relevance column sorting. Users expect descending by score by default on rerank results. Right now default is by 'created_at'. Can we switch default sort when view is 'rerank'?
Jess: Yes — set default sort to relevance_score desc when dataset has rerank flag. Add small helper text under the header: 'Showing reranked results — sorted by relevance'.
Priya: Copy updates: 'Copy CSV' button tooltip should include file format and columns exported. Eg: 'Copy CSV — columns: id, text_snippet, vector_norm, relevance_score'. Screen readers will read the tooltip but make sure it's visible on hover too.
a11y-bot: Also ensure color contrast of the cluster icons meets AA. Current pale gray on white fails for small icons.
Amar: Action items: 1) update microcopy for buttons (Jess), 2) implement CSV truncation flag + backend flag (Sam), 3) switch default sort for rerank views (Lee), 4) ARIA labels and contrast fixes (Priya).
Jess: I'll draft a tiny copy doc and post in PR. Can someone volunteer to pair on the keyboard/menu implementation?
Lee: I can take the menu + mobile collapse.
Sam: I'll own the serializer change and coordinate with infra if we need a config.
Priya: I'll do the a11y review and run screen reader pass.
Jess: Thanks. One last UX ask — add a small inline toast that appears after copy: 'CSV copied to clipboard — contains first 200 chars of text_snippet'. That will prevent surprise.
Amar: +1 :thumbsup:
Jess: I'll send the copy doc in ~30m and open a design PR with the mock.
Sam: ping me on the PR for the backend toggle.
Priya: leaving a11y checklist in the PR template: focus order, aria labels, keyboard traps, color contrast.
Lee: cool. Closing loop: will update the header placement mock and attach mobile collapse states.
Jess: Awesome, thanks all.
